messages.text:
Yes, you can get a refund. The shop's records show the USB wall charger was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). Your request is also within the time limit (refund-policy/v2/window).

The refund is 13.65 BRL, which is what you paid for the charger (refund-policy/v2/amount). To confirm it, use the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't count as confirmation. After you confirm, a staff member has to approve the request (refund-policy/v2/approval). I'll update you once that happens.

messages.text: Thanks. What date should the money reach my card?

The shop can't give you a date. The receipt records the refund in the shop's test ledger. It isn't a bank transfer, and the shop gives no date for the money to appear on a card (refund-policy/v2/payout). Your card issuer handles the credit on its side.
